question: Which of the following months was celebrated as 'Nutrition Month' in India in the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**September.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nutrition Month:**__

 
 
• It was celebrated to **promote nutrition among Women and Children.**
 
• It is also called** Rashtriya Poshan Maah.**
 
• **Rashtriya Poshan Maah** was celebrated in** September 2020.**
 
• **Poshan Maah** is celebrated every year to encourage **Jan Bhagidaari** in order to ensure health and nutrition for everyone. Every year Poshan Maah is celebrated all over the country under POSHAN Abhiyaan, launched in 2018.
 
• The importance of Nutrition in our lives was emphasized by** Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi** in his popular programme** "Mann ki Baat on 30th August 2020.**
 
• **PM Narendra Modi announced to celebrate September as a month of nutrition.**
 
• In his **Mann Ki Baat programme**, he laid emphasis on creating awareness to **fight malnutrition among children, particularly the girl child.**
 
• **Gujarat Government** launched a pilot project, **Poshan Abhiyan**, last year, which is a statewide mission to eradicate malnutrition among children.
